prompt.project_info: Create a 3:4 four-panel photorealistic bedroom fashion portrait collage of one original approved adult woman in a blue-and-white gingham coordinate set.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with platinum-blonde softly waved hair, a large bright red bow headband, direct or gently lowered gaze, soft red lip color, subtle winged eyeliner, and blue geometric stud earrings. She wears a blue-and-white gingham spaghetti-strap crop top with red heart-and-cherry embroidery and white scalloped lace trim, a matching pleated mini-skirt with scalloped lace hem, and no footwear. A small white clutch with gold hardware rests on the bed in selected panels.
composition_elements: Four coordinated panels in one vertical 3:4 collage: reclining on the bed with chin supported by both hands, seated on the bed holding a small object, turned away while seated, and seated beside the bed with one hand near the bow.
Minimalist bright bedroom with white rumpled linen sheets, pillows, and a plain white wall.
Maintain the red bow, gingham weave, embroidery, lace trim, red manicure, clutch, and panel-to-panel identity consistency.
Medium full-body framing with a natural high-angle bedroom perspective and softly readable background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural indoor daylight with subtle bedroom shadows, gentle contrast, candid stylish relaxed atmosphere, and a clean bright neutral palette.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-photorealistic 3:4 collage, iPhone 15 Pro Max natural perspective, sharp fabric and face detail, realistic skin and linen texture, restrained natural grain, no text or watermark.
